name: Samsung Galaxy A15 5G
batteryInfo: 5,000 mAh typical battery with up to 2-day battery life and 25W fast charging support.
cameraInfo: Triple rear camera: 50 MP main (f/1.8), 5 MP ultra-wide, 2 MP macro. 13 MP front camera.
displayInfo: 6.5-inch FHD+ Super AMOLED display with 90Hz refresh rate and 800 nits Vision Booster.
strengths: Large, high-contrast 6.5-inch Super AMOLED screen with high brightness
Very low entry cost and monthly financing ($9.50/mo over 24 months)
tradeoffs: Moderate processor performance; not suited for heavy 3D gaming
Plastic frame and back construction; no wireless charging support

name: Apple iPhone 16 (128GB)
batteryInfo: All-day battery life (up to 22 hours video playback) with fast charging and MagSafe wireless charging.
cameraInfo: Advanced dual-camera system: 48 MP Fusion camera with 2x optical telephoto option, 12 MP ultra-wide with macro support, Camera Control button.
displayInfo: 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR OLED display with up to 2,000 nits peak outdoor brightness and 1 nit minimum brightness.
strengths: Top-tier camera system with 48MP resolution and physical Camera Control button
Exceptional outdoor display visibility (up to 2,000 nits) and text rendering
Comprehensive accessibility ecosystem (VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, MFi hearing support)
tradeoffs: Higher upfront retail price ($829.99) and monthly installment ($34.59/mo over 24 months)
